title: a feature typed by an alias resolves to the aliased element
note: FIXED 2026-09-03 (I4). The parse-time resolver matched the alias `Membership` RELATIONSHIP itself rather than dereferencing it, so `p` was typed by a non-type and validation reported `feature-typing-non-type`. Aliases are bound before anything resolves through them now, and name resolution reads a textual alias's declared name.
